description.en:
Removes one floor attribute from a zone: it clears bit (1 << attr) in the zone's attribute mask, leaving the other attributes and the zone itself in place.
To clear every attribute of a zone at once use CMND_BTL_RESET_FLOOR_ATTR; to remove the zones themselves use CMND_BTL_ALL_RESET_FLOOR.
Nothing happens if no zone has that name.
Name of the zone, as registered with CMND_BTL_REGIST_FLOOR_ATTR.
Bit number of the attribute to remove (0 to 31).

true once the call has run, whether or not the zone was found.
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.

examples.case: Raising one lowered section of the pitch again (real usage, from mf13b01.nut)
Clearing every quicksand depth bit (real usage, from mf15b01.nut)
